{{Top|leg}}
A '''leafship''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder-like]] vehicle constructed by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The bodies of the leafships were made of glue produced from the roots of [[Giant lily|giant lilies]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|247|leafship}}</ref>
